# ASMO (逐日)

> ASMO is a free, open-source calendar and to-do list for macOS that coding agents can use. Claude Code, Codex and other agents read and change it through the `asmo` command line; apps without a shell use its MCP server (`asmo mcp`). The app runs no language model itself. MIT licensed.

## Key facts

- Platform: Apple silicon Mac, macOS 15 or later. Signed with a Developer ID and notarized.
- Price: free, open source, MIT license. No account, no cloud, no subscription.
- Data: a local file in the app's sandbox; the app is the only writer, and open windows update while an agent works.
- Agent surface: `asmo today | day | list | search | add | set | done | rm | page | attach | routine | date | undo | mcp | setup`. Answers are JSON.
- Day pages: written in Markdown (headings, emphasis, links, lists, checkboxes, quotes, tables, code blocks, pictures by path or URL, mermaid diagrams drawn by a bundled copy of mermaid). Read back as blocks b1, b2… that can be replaced or removed one at a time.
- Undo: `asmo undo` takes back changes made through the command until the app restarts.
- Interface: English and Chinese; content is never translated.

## Links

- Source: https://github.com/realAllenSong/ASMO
